full_prompt_en: A cinematic digital interior painting shows a quiet room facing an enormous window full of storm clouds. The window stands slightly right of center, its dark horizontal bars dividing luminous blue-green sky from deeper cloud banks. Outside, swollen white and gray clouds roll upward with a soft, almost painterly texture, providing the main light in the image. Inside, the steep ceiling and walls are dark teal, with framed pictures barely visible along the left wall and above the window. A single seated person appears in near silhouette at the lower left, turned toward the weather. A small amber lamp glows behind the chair, its warm halo touching nearby objects without reaching the far corners. Houseplants cluster across the sill and swell into a large shadowed mass on the right, their leaves creating delicate, broken edges against the glass. A low table sits near the bottom center, its top just discernible in the dimness. The scene is organized by a dramatic value reversal: the restless exterior is bright and spacious, while the domestic foreground is enclosed, soft, and almost black. Fine grain and veiled contours keep details from feeling clinically rendered, yet the window frame, chair, and plant silhouettes hold the space together. The whole frame carries a sheltered stillness beside the vast movement of weather outside.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅具有电影感的数字室内绘画描绘一间安静的房间，正对着填满暴风云的大窗。窗户稍偏画面右侧，深色横框将发光的蓝绿色天空与更深的云带分开。窗外，隆起的白灰色云团以柔和、近乎绘画般的肌理向上翻卷，成为整幅图像的主要光源。室内陡斜的天花板和墙壁呈深青色，左侧墙上和窗上方的相框只隐约可见。一位坐着的人在左下方呈现近乎剪影的身形，朝向窗外天气。椅后小小的琥珀色台灯发亮，暖色光晕触到近处物件，却到不了房间更远的角落。室内植物聚在窗台，又在右侧膨胀为大片阴影，叶片在玻璃前形成纤细而断续的边缘。低矮的桌子放在下方中央，桌面在昏暗中勉强可辨。场景由戏剧性的明度反转组织起来：翻涌的户外明亮而开阔，家居前景则包裹、柔软，几乎全黑。细颗粒和蒙着雾似的轮廓避免细节显得机械精确，而窗框、椅子和植物剪影仍支撑起空间。整幅画在窗外巨大天气运动的旁边，保持一种受到庇护的静止感。
style_prompt_en: The cinematic digital painting is organized around a bright cool rectangle enclosed by broad, almost black teal masses. Pale blue-green and clouded white spread across the luminous center, while a single compact amber glow warms one side of the dark foreground. Window-like structural lines give the composition stability; softer organic silhouettes interrupt those straight edges and create fine irregular detail. Interior forms are mostly value shapes with only selective readable contours. Grain, haze, and restrained painterly softness keep the contrast atmospheric rather than sharp or glossy. Light appears to enter from beyond the central opening, feathering across nearby edges but leaving the periphery deeply shaded. The image balances a restless, billowing light area with calm, enclosed darkness. The whole frame feels contemplative and sheltered through this measured separation of cool expansiveness and warm intimacy.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅电影感数字绘画以一个明亮的冷色矩形为中心，周围包裹着宽阔、近乎黑色的深青色体量。浅蓝绿色与云雾般的白色铺在发光中央，一处紧凑的琥珀色暖光为深暗前景的一侧带来温度。类似窗框的结构线条让构图稳定，更柔软的有机剪影则打断这些直线，形成纤细的不规则细节。内部形体大多作为明度块面出现，只有少量轮廓清晰可辨。颗粒、薄雾和克制的绘画式柔边让对比保持氛围感，而非锐利或光滑。光仿佛从中央开口之外进入，轻轻渗过近处边缘，却让周边留在深影里。图像以翻涌而发亮的区域平衡安静封闭的黑暗。整幅画通过冷色的开阔感与暖色的亲密感之间克制的分隔，显得沉思而安稳。
theme_en: Watching storm clouds from a dim room
theme_zh: 在昏暗房间里看暴风云
name: Depressed atmosphere
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
